title: Spring-loading future performance when no one is looking Earnings and cash flow management around acquisitions

rival_explanations: target interim understatement is merely a reversal of pre-announcement earnings overstatement
interim earnings decline because target activity levels decline (reduced manager effort, divestitures, deferred customer purchases)
interim earnings decline because costs increase rather than deliberate understatement
restructuring charges recognized after the merger create a negative cross-sectional relation between pre-acquisition target earnings and post-acquisition earnings

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (U.S. corporations; acquirer and target firms across sectors)
context.country_region: United States (both acquirers and targets are U.S. firms)
context.sample_size: 2128 deals (drops to 1404 when testing P2 and P3, which require nonmissing acquirer data)

data_sources.name: Post-acquisition SEC filings (10-Q reports), hand-collected case-by-case

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: 2128 M&A completed 1985-2010; Panel C = pooling-method subsample; Panel D = large deals (target >50% of acquirer market value of equity)

dv.name: Target abnormal performance during interim quarter

key_ivs.name: Interim quarter vs. quarter before (period around acquisition)
key_ivs.measure: Comparison of interim quarter (quarter 0) with the quarter before (quarter -1); same-firm prior quarter used as control

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: 1865-2128 target firm-quarters depending on lag availability

dv.name: Target abnormal performance across prior quarters

key_ivs.name: Quarter relative to interim quarter (1 through 8 quarters before vs. interim quarter)
key_ivs.measure: Time-series of T_DE and T_abCFO for the interim quarter and each of the prior eight quarters

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: Exploratory subsample: first 300 observations sorted by acquirer CUSIP; stub earnings computable for 106 observations, sales for 93 observations

key_ivs.name: Stub portion vs. quarter before
key_ivs.measure: Difference between seasonally differenced stub-portion earnings/sales and the quarter before; stub numbers put on a quarter-equivalent basis (divide by calendar days, multiply by 91)

analyses.label: Table 5 (Test of P2): acquirer (combined entity) post-acquisition performance overstatement over first four quarters vs. benchmark quarters (Panel A all firms, Panel B 518 large deals, Panel C large-deal pooling subsample)
analyses.sample: Full sample (Panel A); Panel B = 518 large deals (deal value >50% of acquirer market value); Panel C = large-deal pooling subsample

key_ivs.name: Post-acquisition quarter (quarters +1 to +4 vs. benchmark quarters +5 to +8)
key_ivs.measure: Time-series comparison of first four post-acquisition quarters to benchmark quarters +5 through +8

analyses.label: Table 6 (Test of P3): regressions of combined-entity performance on target interim-period understatement plus controls (Panels A1/A2 all deals, first/second post-acquisition quarter; Panels B1/B2 large deals)
analyses.sample: 1404 acquisitions with nonmissing acquirer data (Panels A1/A2); Panels B1/B2 = 518 large deals

key_ivs.name: Target earnings understatement (T_DEU)
key_ivs.measure: Interim-quarter seasonally differenced earnings minus the corresponding number in the quarter before, scaled by CBV

key_ivs.name: Target cash flow understatement (T_abCFOU)
key_ivs.measure: Interim-quarter abnormal cash flows minus the corresponding number in the quarter before, scaled by CBV

key_ivs.name: POOLING x target understatement interaction (POOLING*T_DEU, POOLING*T_abCFOU)
key_ivs.measure: Interaction of pooling indicator (1 if pooling of interests, 0 if purchase) with target understatement measures

controls.name: PctStock (fraction of deal value paid as stock)
PRE_ACC (acquirer abnormal annual accruals over 3 years before the acquisition)

analyses.label: Table 7: market reaction to earnings announcements - regressions of three-day market adjusted returns on earnings surprises and target understatement (Panel A targets, Panel B acquirers)
analyses.sample: Panel A = target earnings announcements; Panel B = acquirer earnings announcements

key_ivs.name: Acquirer earnings surprise (C_FE)
key_ivs.measure: Combined-entity analyst forecast error for the post-acquisition quarters

key_ivs.name: Target earnings understatement (T_DEU)
key_ivs.measure: Estimate of target earnings understatement transferred to the acquirer (as in Table 6)

constructs: costs and benefits of such earnings management
